definitions.explanation: An extremely small particle, often invisible to the naked eye. Used in scientific, environmental, and everyday health contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{微粒子|びりゅうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測定|そくてい}→測定：04398_sokutei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To measure fine particles in the air.

examples.japanese: ⟦マスク→マスク：05075_masuku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{微粒子|びりゅうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{侵入|しんにゅう}→侵入：11440_shinnyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧。
examples.english: Masks prevent the entry of fine particles.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{排出|はいしゅつ}される→排出する：25377_haishutsusuru⟧{微粒子|びりゅうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悪影響|あくえいきょう}→悪影響：16840_akueikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{及|およ}ぼす→及ぼす：02028_oyobosu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧になった。
examples.english: Research has revealed that fine particles emitted from factories have adverse effects on health.

notes:
A compound of {微|び} (fine; minute) and ⟦{粒子|りゅうし}→粒子：14970_ryuushi⟧ (particle). Commonly encountered in discussions about air quality, pollution, and scientific research.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {微粒子|びりゅうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{含|ふく}む→含む：01982_fukumu⟧: to contain fine particles
- {微粒子|びりゅうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{除去|じょきょ}する→除去する：22368_jokyosuru⟧: to remove fine particles
- ⟦{大気|たいき}→大気：03388_taiki⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{微粒子|びりゅうし}: airborne fine particles
- {微粒子|びりゅうし}⟦{状|じょう}→状：09878_jou⟧: in the form of fine particles

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{粒子|りゅうし}→粒子：14970_ryuushi⟧: particle — general term for particles of any size
- PM2.5: particulate matter 2.5 — specific measure of fine airborne particles 2.5 micrometers or smaller
- {粉塵|ふんじん}: dust; particulate matter — airborne dust and debris, especially in industrial settings
- ⟦{花粉|かふん}→花粉：04372_kafun⟧: pollen — a specific type of airborne particle causing allergies
